text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as Satono Diamond's debut race draws near…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I don't mean to overstep, but there is something I felt you should know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Satono's debut race is likely to attract a great deal of attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen holds out a magazine with the attention-grabbing headline "The 500-Million-RKST-Point Debut Race!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: RKST—the acronym stands for "Rookie Knowledge, Stats, and Talent."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: RKST points are announced annually in July and refer to an Umamusume's evaluation points before they debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The points are determined by retired trainers and racing critics who analyze the abilities of Umamusume and convert their evaluations into numerical scores.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond earned a staggering 230 million points, putting her among the highest ranking Umamusume in history. Furthermore, she's been garnering huge attention leading up to her debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Another Umamusume with an even higher evaluation score than Satono will be running in the same debut race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Other high-scoring Umamusume will be competing too. Collectively, the total points from all racers exceed 500 million.
choice_data_list: So that's why it's being called the "500-Million-Point Battle," huh?
So that's why it's being called the "500-Million-Point Battle," huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I suspect public attention will continue to escalate, but Satono should be fine. Nevertheless, I wished to let you know.
choice_data_list: Thanks for the heads up. We'll be careful.
Thanks for the heads up. We'll be careful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No matter how self-assured and composed Satono Diamond usually is, this is her debut race, so it's prudent to be overly cautious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Good. With so many eyes on her, it's only natural for dissenting opinions on her to arise.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's make today a good one!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Hey, Satono Diamond is here!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: There sure are a lot of reporters out and about today…

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond, could we have a few minutes of your time, please?
choice_data_list: Sorry, we're just about to start training…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's fine, Trainer. I don't mind a short interview.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! Your upcoming debut looks set to be a showdown between you and several other high-scoring Umamusume. What are your thoughts going into it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that what people are saying?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm ecstatic to be on the receiving end of so much attention, and I plan to put on a performance worthy of my score during my debut.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Are you feeling any pressure?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I think everyone is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond handles the questions flawlessly. She seems wholly nonplussed by the hype surrounding the high-point showdown.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Whew… Sorry for the wait. I'm done now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well, my throat is a little dry.
choice_data_list: Should I put a cap on interviews for you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This period leading up to her debut is a critical one. If we ask, I'm sure Tazuna can limit how many interviews we receive.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No, it's fine. Giving interviews is part and parcel of being a runner.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: In fact, it's a blessing if it gets everyone excited for my debut.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm sure my family is thankful for the attention as well!
choice_data_list: Isn't being in the spotlight a burden?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm very used to it. I've been the center of attention in the Satono family since I was young.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: On occasion, people would bombard me at parties with questions on my lap times or if I planned to attend Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Other Umamusume, including my relatives, were often envious of the spotlight that followed me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She shows no signs of feeling any pressure. It seems she really is used to the attention.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, but do you find the interviews irksome?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm happy to refuse them if they're interfering with my training.
choice_data_list: That's okay! I don't have any complaints if you don't!
That's okay! I don't have any complaints if you don't!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's the one worrying about me instead of the other way around. If she isn't bothered, it's probably best not to dwell on it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the day of her debut race arrives…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's finally time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I am. When I think about how my adventures in the Twinkle Series are finally beginning…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I can't help but get chills and goosebumps all over!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond doesn't show the slightest sign of nerves. Instead, she's overflowing with enthusiasm.
choice_data_list: Get out there and show them you mean business!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Absolutely! Satono Diamond, moving out!
